description: Java class defining an MQTT rule engine node for Thingsboard, handling MQTT client initialization, message publishing, and configuration upgrades.

classes.name: TbMqttNode
classes.description: Java class implementing an external MQTT node for Thingsboard rule engine, managing MQTT client lifecycle, message publishing, and configuration upgrades.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MQTT node, setting up configuration and MQTT client.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, publishing them to MQTT broker.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Processes exceptions during message publishing, adding error info to message metadata.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disconnecting MQTT client.

methods.name: getOwnerId
methods.description: Generates owner ID string based on context.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes and connects the MQTT client with proper configuration.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Generates and validates MQTT client ID based on configuration and context.

methods.name: prepareMqttClientConfig
methods.description: Prepares MQTT client configuration, including credentials.

methods.name: getSslContext
methods.description: Retrieves SSL context if SSL is enabled.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Extracts message data, optionally converting to plain text.
